known: Existing ETo-only regional outputs, synthetic groundwater and two modern groundwater source studies are exposed development. No new rainfall or joint meteorological forcing arrays inspected.
scope: Source/input preflight only: same30fixed samples, all1507existing candidates,2020–2024LST. Build common-period temperature/rain/ETo arrays before any new field comparison. No groundwater, crop/yield/default adoption.

weather_grid.assignment: Half-open one-degree tile containing each field; request tile-centre latitude=floor(field_lat)+0.5 and longitude=floor(field_lon)+0.5. No interpolation, point-ratio scaling or terrain correction. Retain every candidate.
weather_grid.provider: NASA POWER agricultural daily point API; fixed sampling lattice, NOT a claim of one-degree native data resolution
weather_grid.capture: Retain raw source bytes, URLs, units, provider/grid elevations and semantic hashes for all30cells. Same declared QA as the three-location audit. Report all missingness. If any assigned positive-area cell lacks complete qualified weather, preserve it and leave the affected basin comparison unscored; no selective removal or silent fallback. Retry transient requests without changing cells or years; maximum4concurrent requests.

overlap: Compare all eight old weather variables, every date, provider coordinates/elevation and units against the frozen regional source. Reuse reviewed ETo only for exact-equal overlapping numerical inputs. Preserve any changed sample and leave affected forcing unqualified until a new full joint evaporation review; no fallback or cherry-picking.
rain_policy: PRECTOTCORR must contain all1827dates at each30samples with finite nonnegative data and declared mm/day. Each full LST day contributes rate times one day. Sum actual Gregorian month amounts,average five same-month totals,spread unchanged totals across equal model bins; preserve mean annual total including leap days.
temperature_policy: For each sample/year/Gregorian month,average daily T2M degreesC,then equal-weight the five same-month means. These physical temperature means map to the12existing bins. Do not scale degreesC to conserve a Celsius integral; constant temperature remains constant. Daily variance/thermal extremes and interannual variability are not represented by monthly means.
assignment: Exactly reuse all1507prior field/sample indices and distances. Do not reselect candidates or local grid thresholds.
review: Independent raw dates/units/missingness/overlap and scalar/Decimal aggregation checks; every sample bin and field assignment,full CSV and four fresh files. Pin prior942protected outputs plus all local-source numeric exports and review. No model fields until this source preflight is frozen and reviewed.
limits: Modern gridded short-period meteorology,not ancient reconstruction,station validation or a long climatic normal. Frozen Aswan1871–1901 and Hit1965–1971 selected-year flow means remain different epochs; a later paired field sensitivity must state that. Crop/soil/phenology,shared fantasy weather/flow,Tigris and independent validation remain open.
